content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"The \"Ishan Uday\" Special Scholarship Scheme For North Eastern Region is a scholarship program with the following key details: [E01] Applicants must be domiciles of the North Eastern Region with parental annual income not exceeding ₹4,50,000/- per annum, and must have passed Class 12th or equivalent. [E01] The scholarship is provided for general degree courses and technical and professional courses, including medical and paramedical courses, at eligible universities, colleges, and institutes. [E01] Scholarships are renewed during the first degree course subject to good conduct and attendance, and students who fail to get promoted forfeit the scholarship. [E01] Change of course results in forfeiture of the scholarship. [E02] Payment is made through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). [E02] The application process is completely free and conducted online at https://scholarships.gov.in/. [E02] The North Eastern States eligible under the scheme are Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura. [E03] Transgender candidates are eligible to apply, and reservation for Persons with Disability follows Government of India norms.","cited_evidence_ids":["E01","E02","E03"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"Applicants must be domiciles of the North Eastern Region with parental annual income not exceeding ₹4,50,000/- per annum, and must have passed Class 12th or equivalent.","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"The scholarship is provided for general degree courses and technical and professional courses, including medical and paramedical courses, at eligible universities, colleges, and institutes.","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"Scholarships are renewed during the first degree course subject to good conduct and attendance, and students who fail to get promoted forfeit the scholarship.","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"Change of course results in forfeiture of the scholarship.","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"Payment is made through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).","evidence_ids":["E02"]},{"claim":"The application process is completely free and conducted online at https://scholarships.gov.in/.","evidence_ids":["E02"]},{"claim":"The North Eastern States eligible under the scheme are Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura.","evidence_ids":["E02"]},{"claim":"Transgender candidates are eligible to apply, and reservation for Persons with Disability follows Government of India norms.","evidence_ids":["E03"]}]}
